# Partsgate

> Governed ordering for hardware agents. An MCP server that lets an AI agent buy electronic components from Mouser and DigiKey on the buyer's own account, inside per-agent spend mandates, with human approval above a threshold. Pre-launch; domain and name are placeholders.

Every page has a Markdown twin. Prefer these.

## Docs
- [Connect your agent](https://partsgate.example/docs/connect.md): the one command per client, and how to get an API key
- [Mandates and approvals](https://partsgate.example/docs/mandates.md): limits, approval flow, order states, error codes
- [The six tools](https://partsgate.example/docs/tools.md): search_catalog, get_product, create_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, get_order

## Product
- [Home](https://partsgate.example/index.md): what it is and the first use case
- [Pricing](https://partsgate.example/pricing.md): design partner free tier, flat per company afterwards

## Optional
- [MCP endpoint](https://partsgate.example/mcp): Streamable HTTP, bearer agent key
- [UCP discovery profile](https://partsgate.example/.well-known/ucp)
